note: Plan for .github/workflows/benchmark.yml, expanded by scripts/bench/data/plan_matrix.py after the data jobs, so the shards follow the cases that actually passed QC. Each run = model group x dataset, cut into jobs of casesPerJob cases (cases.csv order) so a job stays < 3 h on a 4-vCPU runner: nnU-Net ~30 min/case; the nine LightningMedSeg3D nets ~30 min/case together; MSD/LiTS volumes are larger (up to 917 slices), hence 3 per job. Cases already in the benchmark-results-v1 release (same model sha256 + case) are skipped by the runner and publish dedupes, so the 10 HCC-TACE-Seg / 10 MSD cases published earlier are not recomputed. nnU-Net x MSD is resubstitution and is not run (its 10 original MSD cases are already published). 'include' (explicit jobs with model or models, dataset, cases) replaces the plan when non-empty.

nnunet_ens5.note: NOT ENABLED — benchmark.yml only reads .include. nnU-Net 5-fold ensemble (nnunet_liver_lits_ens5.json; members nnunet_liver_lits + _f1.._f4 from the zenodo-models-v1 release). Runtime per case on a 4-vCPU runner, from nnU-Net fold 0's median 1853 s/case (inference dominates; softmax/flip overhead is <1%): 5-fold without TTA ≈ 5 × 1853 s ≈ 9.3e3 s ≈ 2.6 h per case; 5-fold + mirror TTA (8 variants) ≈ 40 × 1853 s ≈ 7.4e4 s ≈ 20.6 h per case. That is over the 6 h GitHub-hosted job limit, so TTA needs a larger or self-hosted runner. Without TTA, one case per job fits. To enable: move the entries into .include, and have benchmark.yml's 'Model from release' step also download the members listed in the ensemble manifest (ensemble.members[].file). For the no-TTA variant, pass runnerArgs to run-benchmark.ts. Memory: 5 CPU sessions preloaded with arenas off (≈ 5 × 125 MB of weights + one 128³ activation set at a time).
